note: Engine profiles v2: an engine is selected together with a MODE - 'resident' (everything in VRAM) or 'hybrid' (CPU/DRAM + NVMe tiering where the engine supports it). Hybrid is a capability dimension across engines, not a separate engine: SGLang has both entries, vLLM and llama.cpp have hybrid variants, TensorFold's hybrid is REJ with its reopen trigger, DeepInfer is resident-only, FLARE has no modes. Verdict vocabulary matches the tried-options ledger: ADOPT / REJ / PARKED / CLOSED; a mode the ledger rejected is never recommended without citing its reopen trigger. Verified against research/engines.md (fresh fetches 2026-10-23).

sglang.label: SGLang
sglang.what_it_is: Apache-2.0 serving framework; Paged Experts (merged 2026-10-19: K-of-E GPU residency, auto-K sized from safetensors headers + mem-fraction + KV reserve); HiCache KV offload tiers; Waterfill/LPLB dispatch; the reference recipe runs SGLang + kt-kernel.

resident.label: resident (GPU-only, upstream SGLang)
resident.calibration_anchor: none in this repo yet (upstream Paged Experts numbers are the seed)

hybrid.label: hybrid (kt-kernel CPU tier + Engram + hot map)
hybrid.runtime_placement: upstream Paged Experts; local T3.8d in progress (a6c5b82)

vllm.label: vLLM
vllm.what_it_is: the reference GPU-resident server; v0.31 adds weight offload (--cpu-offload-gb/--cpu-offload-params, UVA backend), per-component Engram host offload, and KV tiering (CPU + persistent filesystem, TieringOffloadingSpec); owns the recipes schema rendered at recipes.vllm.ai.
vllm.verdict: ADOPT as schema/provenance source + both modes; hybrid is author-planned offload, not a routing-aware CPU compute tier

resident.label: resident (GPU-only)
resident.calibration_anchor: V4-Flash NVFP4 baseline was vLLM: 171-239 tok/s C1 (E8)

hybrid.label: hybrid (weight offload + KV tiering)
hybrid.verdict: ADOPT as secondary hybrid tier (named-parameter offload, no CPU compute of experts)

llama-cpp.label: llama.cpp / llama-server
llama-cpp.what_it_is: the universal local-inference engine; -ot regex tensor offload, --n-cpu-moe MoE offload, draft --moe-expert-cache LRU.
llama-cpp.verdict: ADOPT for the small-model tier; deepseek41/CSA2 route PARKED on upstream (ggml-org/llama.cpp#28696)

hybrid.label: hybrid (CPU offload: -ot / --n-cpu-moe / --moe-expert-cache)
hybrid.verdict: ADOPT as the small-model hybrid tier
hybrid.calibration_anchor: published llama.cpp offload numbers (seed, not local)

tensorfold.label: TensorFold
tensorfold.what_it_is: single Zig binary (Metal + CUDA); EXL3/TR3/EXLR8/MLX/NVFP4 recipes, revision-pinned pulls, memory-floor reporting, portable receipts; DeepSeek not served yet (gate #827).
tensorfold.verdict: resident tier: ADOPT for quant-shrunk shapes; hybrid: REJ here (no CPU/NVMe weight offload - the ledger rule wins, T3.32)

resident.label: resident (quant-shrunk)
resident.verdict: ADOPT for quant-shrunk single/paired machines (DeepSeek gated on #827)

hybrid.label: hybrid (UNSUPPORTED - no CPU/NVMe weight offload)
hybrid.verdict: REJ - TensorFold has no CPU/NVMe offload tier (ledger T3.32). Reopen trigger: gate #827 or a published SM120 EXL3 MoE kernel with a KL number

deepinfer.label: DeepSeek DeepInfer
deepinfer.what_it_is: DeepSeek's production inference runtime, open-sourced 2026-10-16; offline inference for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; no server/KV layer yet; SM100 + Ascend 950 only.
deepinfer.serves_shape: multi-GPU EP at V4.x datacenter scale
deepinfer.verdict: ADOPT as the multi-GPU-EP reference tier (watch); not runnable on this SM120 box; borrow batch-invariance + deterministic-sampling gates

flare.label: NVIDIA FLARE
flare.what_it_is: Federated Learning Application Runtime Environment - training/federation orchestration, not a serving engine.
flare.verdict: REJ as engine, CLOSED. Reopen: a real multi-host governance requirement - evaluate plain orchestration first
